length.name: Dhererka
length.description: U beddel cabbirrada dhererka SI, boqortooyada, Mareykanka, iyo kuwa sayniska.
length.note: Dhererka wuxuu u isticmaalaa mitirka sida cabbirka aasaasiga ah.

area.name: Cabbirka
area.description: U beddel cabbirrada dhulka, dhismaha, khariidadaynta, iyo sayniska.
area.note: Aagga wuxuu u isticmaalaa mitirka laba jibaaran sida cabbirka aasaasiga ah.

volume.name: Baaxadda
volume.description: U beddel cabbirrada baaxadda mitirka, Mareykanka, boqortooyada, iyo kariska.
volume.note: Xajmiga wuxuu u isticmaalaa mitirka saddex jibaaran sida cabbirka aasaasiga ah.

weight.name: Miisaanka/Cufnaanta
weight.description: U beddel cufnaanta SI, miisaanka boqortooyada, iyo cutubyada atomiga.
weight.note: Miisaanka wuxuu u isticmaalaa kiiloogaraamka sida cabbirka aasaasiga ah.

temperature.name: Heerkulka
temperature.description: U beddel Celsius, Fahrenheit, Kelvin, iyo miisaannada taariikhiga ah.
temperature.note: Beddellada heerkulku waxay gudaha isticmaalaan Kelvin oo saldhig ah.

time.name: Waqtiga
time.description: U beddel waqtiga SI, waqtiga rayidka, iyo muddooyinka taariikhiga ah.
time.note: Bilaha iyo sannadaha waxay isticmaalaan celceliska sannadka Gregorian-ka.

speed.name: Xawaaraha
speed.description: U beddel cabbirrada xawaaraha waddada, duulimaadka, iyo badda.
speed.note: Xawaaraha wuxuu u isticmaalaa mitir ilbiriqsi kasta sida cabbirka aasaasiga ah.

pressure.name: Cadaadiska
pressure.description: U beddel pascal, bar, PSI, iyo cirka.
pressure.note: Cadaadiska wuxuu u isticmaalaa baaskaalka sida cabbirka aasaasiga ah.

energy.name: Tamarta
energy.description: U beddel joule, calorie, kilowatt-hour, iyo BTU.
energy.note: Tamarta wuxuu u isticmaalaa juulka sida cabbirka aasaasiga ah.

power.name: Awoodda
power.description: U beddel watt, xoogga faraska, iyo tan qaboojinta.
power.note: Awoodda wuxuu u isticmaalaa waatka sida cabbirka aasaasiga ah.

force.name: Xoogga
force.description: U beddel newton, dyne, iyo pound-force.
force.note: Xoogga wuxuu u isticmaalaa nyuutonka sida cabbirka aasaasiga ah.

torque.name: Torque
torque.description: U beddel newton meter, pound-foot, iyo pound-inch.
torque.note: Isbeddelka wareegga wuxuu u isticmaalaa nyuuton-mitirka sida cabbirka aasaasiga ah.

electricity.name: Korontada
electricity.description: U beddel cutubyada korontada oo xisaabi voltage, current, iyo resistance.
electricity.note: Cabbirrada koronto ee isla qoyska si toos ah ayaa loo beddelaa; natiijooyinka u dhexeeya qoysas kala duwan waxay isticmaalaan sharciga Ohm iyo macluumaadka wakhtiga.

frequency.name: Baaxadda-mowjadaha
frequency.description: U beddel hertz, horgalayaasha frequency-ga, iyo RPM.
frequency.note: Inta jeer (frequency) wuxuu u isticmaalaa hertz-ka sida cabbirka aasaasiga ah.

digital.name: Kaydinta Dhijitaalka
digital.description: U beddel bits, bytes, iyo kaydinta tobanle ama labanle.
digital.note: Kaydinta Dhijitaalka ah wuxuu u isticmaalaa bits-ka sida cabbirka aasaasiga ah.

angle.name: Gollaha
angle.description: U beddel radian, digrii, gradian, iyo wareeg.
angle.note: Xagalka wuxuu u isticmaalaa radian-ka sida cabbirka aasaasiga ah.

density.name: Cufnaanta
density.description: U beddel kumanaan isku-dar cufnaanta cufka/baaxadda.
density.note: Cufnaanta wuxuu u isticmaalaa kiiloogaraam mitir saddex jibaaran kasta sida cabbirka aasaasiga ah.

flow.name: Heerka Qulqulka
flow.description: U beddel heerarka qulqulka baaxadda ee mitirka iyo Mareykanka.
flow.note: Xawaaraha Qulqulka wuxuu u isticmaalaa mitir saddex jibaaran ilbiriqsi kasta sida cabbirka aasaasiga ah.

fuel_economy.name: Dhaqaalaha Shidaalka
fuel_economy.description: U beddel MPG, km/L, iyo L/100 km.
fuel_economy.note: Dhaqaalaha shidaalku wuxuu u rogayaa u dhexeeya qaabka masaafo-kor-xajmi iyo xajmi-kor-masaafo.

radiation.name: Shucaaca
radiation.description: U beddel cutubyada shucaaca iyo qiyaasta la nuugay.

chemistry.name: Kiimikada
chemistry.description: U beddel cutubyada isku-dhafka, molarity-ga, iyo shaybaarka.

agriculture.name: Beeraha
agriculture.description: U beddel acre, hectare, wax-soosaarka, iyo cutubyada beeraha.
agriculture.note: Beddellada beeraha waxaa loo kooxeeyaa aagga, heerka miisaanka, heerka dareeraha, iyo heerka wax-soo-saarka.

cooking.name: Karinta
cooking.description: U beddel cutubyada baaxadda iyo cufka ee cuntooyinka lagu isticmaalo.
cooking.note: Cabbirrada karinta waxay kuxirantahay cabbirka (dimension) sababtoo ah xajmiga iyo miisaanku waxay u baahan yihiin cufnaanta si loo isku daro.

astronomy.name: Cilmiga Xiddigiska
astronomy.description: U beddel cutubyada cilmiga xiddigiska ee dhererka, cufka, iyo waqtiga.

engineering.name: Injineernimada
engineering.description: U beddel cutubyada injineernimada ee cadaadiska, xoogga, torque-ga, iyo tamarta.
engineering.note: Cabbirrada injineernimada waxaa loo kooxeeyaa cabbirro is waafaqsan.

scientific.name: Sayniska
scientific.description: U beddel cutubyada ka soo jeeda SI iyo shaybaarka sayniska.
scientific.note: Cabbirrada sayniska waxaa loo kooxeeyaa cabbirro is waafaqsan.

currency.name: Lacagta
currency.description: U beddel lacagaha ugu waaweyn adduunka iyadoo la adeegsanayo qiimayaal khadka-ka-baxsan.
currency.note: Qiimayaasha lacagtu waa qiyaasyo offline-ka ah illaa iyo inta aan la soo geli qiimayaasha API-ga toos ah.

faq.q1_answer: 1 {FROM} waxay la mid tahay {FACTOR} {TO}, iyadoo la adeegsanayo lambarka isbeddelka ee sax ah ee la go'aamiyay, ee aan ahayn qiyaas.
faq.q2_answer: Ku dhufo qiimaha {FROM_LOWER} lambarka {FACTOR}. Isbeddelayaasha kore ayaa isla markiiba sameeya sixitaanka aad dooratay.
faq.q3_answer: Isticmaal lambarka rogan: 1 {TO} waxay la mid tahay {INV_FACTOR} {FROM}. Sidoo kale waxaad isticmaali kartaa badalka isbeddelaha si aad si degdeg ah u rogto jihada.
faq.q6_answer: Haa. Lambarka isbeddelka waa mid go'an, marka wax kasta oo dhammaystiran oo aad aragto waa doorasho muuqaal ah, mana aha xaddidaad xisaabineed.
faq.temp_q1_answer: 1 {FROM} waxay la mid tahay {FACTOR} {TO}, iyadoo la adeegsanayo qaacidada leexinta heerkulka, ee aan ahayn qiyaas.
faq.temp_q2_answer: Isticmaal qaacidada kor lagu muujiyay: waxay ku lug leedahay isku dhufasho iyo isku darid/ka-jarid labadaba, sababtoo ah labada heerkul ee la beddelayo ma wadaagaan bar-eber isku mid ah.
faq.temp_q6_answer: Haa. Labada heerkul ee la beddelayo ayaa si rasmi ah loogu qeexay heerkulka Kelvin, sidaa darteed qaacidada isbeddelku waa sax; wax-dhammaystirka kaliya ee aad aragto waa tirada lambarada tobanle ee aad doorato inaad muujiso.
faq.fuel_q2_answer: Halka mararka qaar cabbirrada tamarta shidaalku waxay u baahan yihiin in la rogo halkii laga dhufan lahaa si fudud; isbeddelayaasha kore iyo qaybta qaacidada ayaa si toos ah u qabta arrintaas.
faq.currency_q1_answer: 1 {FROM} waxay la mid tahay {FACTOR} {TO}. Qiimayaasha lacagaha ayaa si joogto ah isu bedbeddela, marka u qaado tan lambar tixraac ah, ee aan ahayn qiime tooska ah.
faq.currency_q2_answer: Ku dhufo lacagta {FROM_LOWER} qiimaha sarifka ee hadda jira. Sababtoo ah qiimayaasha sarifku si joogto ah ayay isu bedbeddelaan, had iyo jeer ka xaqiiji qiimaha isha tooska ah ka hor inta aadan ugu tiirsanayn arrimo dhaqaale.
faq.currency_q6_question: Qiimahan sarifku ma sax baa oo ma cusub yahay?
faq.currency_q6_answer: Maya. Si ka duwan isbeddelka cabbirrada dhabta ah, qiimayaasha sarifka lacagaha ayaa si joogto ah isu bedbeddela intay suuqu ka shaqeynayaan. Qiimaha bogga lagu isticmaalay waa muuqaal tixraac ah, mana aha feed tooska ah, marka wixii macaamil dhab ah ah had iyo jeer eeg isha maaliyadeed ee tooska ah.

whereUsed.hectare: Waxaa loo adeegsadaa adduunka oo dhan, gaar ahaan beeraha, kaymaha, iyo tirakoobka dhulka ee ka baxsan Mareykanka.
whereUsed.kilogram: Waxaa loo adeegsadaa sidii cutubka cufka caadiga ah ee ku dhawaad dhammaan dalalka, marka laga reebo Mareykanka iyo dhawr dal oo kale oo badanaa isticmaala rodolka.
whereUsed.pound: Mareykanka (cutubka ugu weyn ee cufka/miisaanka). Boqortooyada Ingiriiska (isticmaal aan rasmi ahayn iyo tafaariiq qaar). Dhulal ka mid ah Kariibiyanka iyo Baasifigga oo xiriir taariikhi ah la leh UK/Mareykanka.
whereUsed.liter: Cutubka baaxadda caadiga ah ee dareeraha adduunka oo dhan, oo ay ku jirto Mareykanka marka la eego cabitaannada iyo calaamadaynta shidaalka xaalado qaar.
whereUsed.meter: Cutubka dhererka caadiga ah ee adduunka oo dhan marka laga reebo Mareykanka.
whereUsed.mile_per_hour: Mareykanka (xadka xawaaraha waddada iyo qiyaasaha xawaaraha gawaarida). Boqortooyada Ingiriiska (xadka xawaaraha waddada).
whereUsed.psi: Mareykanka (cutubka cadaadiska caadiga ah ee taayirada, qalabka, iyo tuubbooyinka).
whereUsed.square_foot: Mareykanka (guryaha, dhismaha). Boqortooyada Ingiriiska (dhismo iyo guryo qaar).
whereUsed.watt: Cutubka awoodda ee caadiga ah ee sayniska iyo maalinlaha ah ee adduunka oo dhan.

differenceBetween.international acre vs. us survey acre: Eekerka sahanka Mareykanka, oo ku salaysan fuudhka sahanka Mareykanka, wuxuu ka duwan yahay eekerka caalamiga ah ku dhawaad laba qaybood boqol milyan kasta. Mareykanku wuxuu ka saaray fuudhka/eekerka sahanka isticmaalka federaalka dhammaadkii 2022.
differenceBetween.us gallon vs. imperial gallon: Galanka dareeraha Mareykanka (3.785411784 L) iyo galanka imperial-ka Ingiriiska (4.54609 L) waa cutub kala duwan oo isku magac leh; had iyo jeer xaqiiji kan ilaha la isticmaalayo.
differenceBetween.decimal mb vs. binary mib: Warshadaha kaydinta caadi ahaan waxay isticmaalaan megabytes tobanle ah (10⁶ bytes), halka nidaamyada hawlgalka qaarkood ay soo sheegaan mebibytes labanle ah (2²⁰ bytes) laakiin ay ku calaamadeeyaan 'MB' — tani waa sababta caadiga ah ee awoodda la sheegay ee drive-ku ay uga muuqato mid ka yar tan lagu dhawaaqay.
differenceBetween.avoirdupois ounce vs. troy ounce: Awsiga maalinlaha ah (avoirdupois, 28.35 g) ee loo isticmaalo karinta iyo rarista waa cutub ka duwan, kana yar, awsiga troy (31.10 g) ee loo isticmaalo macdanta qaalidda ah sida dahabka iyo lacagta; boggani wuxuu isticmaalaa awsiga maalinlaha ah ee avoirdupois-ka.
differenceBetween.pound-mass vs. pound-force: Boggani wuxuu beddelayaa rodol-cufka (lbm), oo ah cutub cufka. Rodol-xoogga (lbf) waa cutub kale oo qiyaasa xoogga cuf-jiidashadu ku dhaliso rodol-cuf, oo loo isticmaalo xaalado injineernimo sida rodolka iinji laba jibaaran kastaba.
differenceBetween.mechanical horsepower vs. metric horsepo: Xoogga faraska mishiinka (745.7 W) iyo xoogga faraska mitiriga/PS (735.5 W) waxay ka duwan yihiin ku dhawaad 1.4% — warqadda tilmaamaha gaari Mareykan ah ee 'hp' iyo tan Yurub ee 'PS' si toos ah looma isbarbardhigi karo iyada oo aan la beddelin.

acre: Cabbiraadda dhulka beeraha, dhulka xoolaha, iyo hantida miyiga ee Mareykanka
Liisaska guryaha iyo qorshaynta dhulka ee qaybaha dhulka
kilogram: Qiimaynta iyo summadaynta alaabta lagu iibiyo miisaanka ganacsiga tafaariiqda iyo alaabta
Xisaabinta qiyaasta daawooyinka caafimaadka, gaar ahaan qoraallada caafimaadka carruurta iyo kuwa ku salaysan miisaanka
Qeexitaanka dhismaha iyo alaabta ee injineernimada ku salaysan nidaamka mitirka
Qiyaasta sayniska ee cufnaanta kimikada, fiisigiska, iyo cilmi-baarista alaabta

acre: Eekerku wuxuu ka soo jeedaa dhulka Ingriiska dhexe sida cabbir dhul oo waxtar leh: dhul ay laba dibi ay geeddi karaan hal maalin, oo dhererkiisu yahay ku dhawaad hal furlong (660 fuudh) balaadhkiisuna yahay hal chain (66 fuudh), taasoo bixisa 43,560 fuudh oo laba jibaaran ah oo wali la isticmaalo maanta.

Sharciga Edward I ee 1305 ayaa rasmi ka dhigay tirakan. Sannadkii 1959, isla Heshiiskii Caalamiga ah ee Yaadka iyo Rodolka ee go'aamiyay rodolka ayaa sidoo kale go'aamiyay eekerka caalamiga ah oo ah 4046.8564224 mitir laba jibaaran, in kastoo Mareykanku uu si gooni ah u sii haystay 'eekerka sahanka Mareykanka' oo yar ku duwan diiwaannada dhulka qaarkood ilaa la joojiyay 2023.
kilogram: Kii ugu horreeyay ee horseeday kiilogaraamka wuxuu ahaa “grave”, oo Akadeemiyada Sayniska ee Faransiiska ay 1793 ku qeexday cufnaanta hal desimitir jibbaaran oo biyo ah oo ku jira heerkuulka cufnaanta ugu badan. Sababtoo ah erayga “grave” wuxuu la mid ahaa magaca sharafta leh ee “graf”, amarkii kacaanka Faransiiska ee 18-kii Germinal, Sanadka III (7-kii Abriil 1795) ayaa nidaamka magac cusub u baxshay: garaamku wuxuu noqday cabbirka tixraaca, oo lagu qeexay cufnaanta hal sentimitir jibbaaran oo biyo ah oo ku jira heerka barafku ku dhalaalo, kiilogaraamkuna - oo ah kun garaam - wuxuu qaatay doorkii camalka ahaa ee “grave”.

Beddelidda qeexitaankaas ku saleysan biyaha si loo dhigo shay dhab ah waxay u baahnayd shaqo tijaabo ah oo dhab ah: kiimikaystihii Louis Lefèvre-Gineau ayaa 1795 loo xilsaaray inuu si sax ah u qiyaaso miisaanka hal desimitir jibbaaran oo biyo ah, dabadeedna dahabkaristihii boqortooyada hore ee Marc-Étienne Janety ayaa sameeyay silsilad bareeti ah oo matalaysa cufnaantaas la qiyaasay. Waxaa lagu kaydiyay Kaydka Qaranka Faransiiska 1799, waxaana loo yaqaanay Kilogramme des Archives.

Fideynta nidaamka mitirka si siman uma bixin - Napoleon wuxuu wakhti gaaban xaddiday isticmaalkiisa - laakiin Faransiisku wuxuu ka dhigay mid waajib ah 1840, Heshiiska Mitirka ee 1875 (oo ay saxeexeen toddoba iyo toban dal oo ay ku jiraan Mareykanka) ayaana aasaasay BIPM iyo qaab caalami ah oo la wadaago. Qaabka Caalamiga ah ee Kiilogaraamka, oo laga sameeyay biraha baladhiyeem-iridiyeem, oo la aqbalay 1889 loona bixiyay naanays “Le Grand K”, ayaa in ka badan boqol sano u ahaa tixraaca cufnaanta caalamka.

20-kii Maajo 2019, kiilogaraamka ayaa dib loo qeexay iyadoo la go'aamiyay joogtaynta Planck oo ah 6.62607015 × 10⁻³⁴ joule-ilbiriqsi, taasoo hadda suurtagelinaysa in laga sameeyo shaybaar (adoo isticmaalaya miisaanka Kibble) iyada oo aan loo baahnayn shay dhab ah oo la tixraaco.

acre: NIST — US Survey Foot: Revised Unit Conversion Factors — Ku qeexaysa qeexitaanka eekerka caalamiga ah ee 1959 iyo joojinta fuudhka sahanka 2022/2023.
kilogram: BIPM — Kiilogaraamka (cabbirka aasaasiga ah ee SI) — Qeexitaanka rasmiga ah iyo taariikhdiisa tan iyo dib-u-qeexitaankii 2019.
NIST — Kilogram: The Past — Taariikhda cabbirka kiilogaraamka laga bilaabo grave ilaa Qaabka Caalamiga ah ee Kiilogaraamka.
Buug-yaraha SI, daabacaadda 9-aad (2019), Lifaaqa 2 — BIPM — Qoraalka rasmiga ah ee qeexitaanka kiilogaraamka ee ku salaysan joogtaynta Planck.
